extDesc.message: Send downloads to the Aria2 Desktop download manager

secretHint.message: Use "Pair with Aria2 Desktop" above to fill this automatically, or copy it from Settings → RPC Security in the app (the app generates one on first launch)

allowProbe.message: Probe real file names of download links

allowProbeHint.message: When a link has no file name (e.g. cloud-drive direct links), fetch the real name from the file server for naming and sorting. Not needed while the app is running — the app does this itself; only used when the app is not running and the extension talks to the engine directly (that requires site access permission)

probePermissionDenied.message: Site access permission was not granted, so file name probing cannot be enabled

quickSendPlaceholder.message: Paste a download or magnet link

sendSuccessUnclassified.message: Sent (no category matched — saved to the default folder)

engineNotRunning.message: Engine not running — click Start Engine in Aria2 Desktop

connectedButDisabled.message: Connected, but the extension is currently disabled

invalidPort.message: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535

permissionDenied.message: Permission to access $1 was not granted, so this address cannot be used

errDisabled.message: The extension is disabled — enable it in the popup and try again

errCannotConnect.message: Cannot connect to $1 — make sure Aria2 Desktop is running and its engine is started

errUnauthorized.message: Wrong secret — copy it from Aria2 Desktop under Settings → RPC Security

errTimeout.message: Connection timed out — check the host and port

errEngineUnavailable.message: The download engine is not running — start it in Aria2 Desktop and retry

errApiInvalidUrl.message: This link is not supported (http / https / ftp / sftp / magnet only)

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong, please try again

downloadSentToSubdir.message: Added to Aria2 Desktop (saved to the $SUBDIR$ folder)

downloadSentRenamed.message: Added to Aria2 Desktop (existing file kept, saved as $NAME$)

interceptedToSubdir.message: Handed over to Aria2 Desktop (saved to the $SUBDIR$ folder)

interceptedRenamed.message: Handed over to Aria2 Desktop (existing file kept, saved as $NAME$)

rightClickHint.message: You can also right-click a link, video or audio and choose “Download with Aria2 Desktop”

pairHint.message: Click, then press Allow in the app's dialog — the secret is filled in automatically

pairingWaiting.message: Waiting for the app to confirm… press Allow in the Aria2 Desktop dialog

pairingSuccess.message: Paired! The secret has been filled in and saved

pairingDenied.message: You pressed Deny in the app — no secret was granted

pairingForbidden.message: Pairing rejected (app too old, or unsupported source)

pairingTimeout.message: Timed out waiting for confirmation — try pairing again

pairingUnreachable.message: Aria2 Desktop not detected (not running or too old) — you can type the secret manually

pairingFailed.message: Pairing failed — you can type the secret manually

unpairConfirm.message:
Unpair?
This clears the saved access secret and connection settings. You can pair again anytime.

unpairDone.message: Unpaired — connection settings restored to defaults

unpairHint.message: Unpairing only clears the secret stored in this extension. To fully revoke access, change the access secret in Aria2 Desktop under Settings → RPC Security

pasteFailed.message: Cannot read clipboard, please paste manually

sendNeedPairing.message: Pair with Aria2 Desktop first to start sending downloads

pairingInBackground.message: Pairing in progress: switch to Aria2 Desktop and click Allow. This window can be closed — settings save automatically.

interceptAllDesc.message: Browser downloads are handed to Aria2 Desktop automatically (original download cancelled)

allowProbeDesc.message: Fetch real file names for links without one (e.g. cloud-drive direct links). Not needed while the app is running.

pairingDoneDesc.message: Extension connected to Aria2 Desktop — you can send downloads now
